title: Saelee Oh Seeks Double Vag / Double Anal Dates
summary: Artist Saelee Oh joins an ensemble episode about her long friendship with David Choe, the Giant Robot art community, racial humor, friendship and attraction, Tinder-era dating, a proposed matchmaking project, and her detailed ideal-partner checklist. A separate sequence exposes a nonparticipating woman's messages, location, body and intimate encounter. The final hour becomes an on-air employment hearing in which newly hired engineer Shane explains two late uploads, learns that others had already voted to fire him, and receives one conditional final chance. The map gives Saelee's art equal weight to matchmaking, protects absent people, preserves disputes rather than settling them by force, and labels health, consent, stereotype, digital-privacy, and workplace-power failures.
sensitivity: Explicit sexual content; nonparticipant intimate and location privacy; minor-era images; racial, body-size, gender, orientation, and mental-health stereotypes; unauthorized account access and explicit-image impersonation; dating and reproductive misinformation; cannabis and firearm discussion; depression; employer/employee power, threatened firing, humiliation, and personnel allegations; nonconsensual bodily-contact trivia.
speaker_policy: Named dialogue remains withheld. Episode 65 has zero diarized turns and five coarse fixed-window embeddings for a large ensemble. Context identifies the public guest but does not validate acoustic attribution; no independent held-out test has passed.
